shortDescription: Psycasts² — Diablo 2-style psycast skill levels, auto synergies (toggleable off), optional fog-of-war tree, a resizable PoE constellation spec tree, seven ascension constellations, meditation→awakening→3-tier enlightenment (pilgrimage completion reforms a caravan home), enemy psycaster tiers, an XML awakening trigger API, TieringOverrideDef + BalanceOverrideDef handoffs, JSON balance export/import, optional hardcore reset-lockout, full keyed localization, and celebration FX.
body:
(spec excerpt - flat level cap, ISEKAI compat, psylink gate + random-Awakened spawn)

## Testing preference (standing)
ALWAYS launch with companion Modern Psycasts UI (`astryl.ModernPsycastsUI`, a workspace mod at e33ef407d712 — the user's own). For FULL addon coverage also load every installed 1.6 VPE addon: dev.tobot.vpe.betterautocast, Aranmaho.Makai.Psycast, Waffle.FantasyPatches, VanillaExpanded.VPE.Hemosage, Danzen.VPE.BiotechIntegration, Aranmaho.RavenousEye.Wildhunter.Psycast, VPE.Horaxian.Sentinel, Aranmaho.RangerClass, mute.vpesensitivity, VPE.Aeromancer.Sentinel, morton.RetextureVPEAeromancer, VPE.Anima.Sentinel, morton.RetextureVPEAnima, VPE.Arknights.Sentinel, VPE.Blader.Sentinel, VPE.Bugmancer.Sentinel, VPE.Framework.Sentinel, VPE.Deadlife.Sentinel, VPE.Geomancer.Sentinel, VPE.Gravcaster.Sentinel, VPE.Hydromancer.Sentinel, VPE.Luminis.Sentinel, VPE.Mechanitor.Sentinel, VPE.Neurophage.Sentinel, VPE.Oripathy.Sentinel, VPE.PhaseShift.Sentinel, VPE.Umbra.Sentinel, VPE.Veincaster.Sentinel, VPE.Voidweaver.Sentinel, morton.VPEAddOnPsycastCardRetextures, VanillaExpanded.VPE.Puppeteer. EXCLUDED: VPE.Gauranlen.Sentinel (missing dep vanillaexpanded.ideo.dryads), VPE.BiotechIntegration.Adendum, gwibbo.morepsygenes + Sl4vP0weR.NoPsycasts (not 1.6), VPersonaWeaponsE. Palette pins (tools take "T: " prefix; category is NOT a path segment): "Actions\T: Force awakening (Tier I)", "Actions\T: Grant psycaster level (+1)", "Actions\T: Max all psycast skills (absolute cap)". Known-unrelated noise: VPE .dds Texture2D load errors (e.g. PathBG_Archon.dds from workshop 2842502659). cs-assets.json drift warnings for UI/Specs/* are concatenation false positives; keep them. NOTE: isolated test sessions keep their OWN mod-settings config (test-savedata/Config/Mod_*.xml); the Bake button writes ManualBalance.json into the mod folder itself, which persists.

## Fog of war, synergy on/off, hardcore reset-lockout, resizable constellation, pilgrimage caravan-reform, modpack balance import (2026-07-13)
- **Fog of war** (`fogOfWar`, default OFF; Skills tab). Hides un-learned psycast identities behind a dark "?" cover until unlocked. Repaint-only block in `Patch_DrawAbility.Postfix` (no ButtonInvisible, so VPE's click-to-unlock passes through; cover vanishes when learned). Tooltip suppressed via `SkillTooltip.NotifyFogHover(rect)` (sets suppressRect but ability=null). Tree lines stay visible.
- **Disable synergies/empowers** (`disableSynergies`, default OFF; Skills tab). StatMultiplier skips the synergy source loop (own-level scaling + specs still apply); tooltip skips received/empowers (Model.synergiesOff); hover-pulse guarded. TabSpec shows amber `PS_SetSynDisabledNote`.
- **Hardcore reset-lockout** (`disableSkillReset`, `disableSpecReset`, default OFF). Hide the psycast-tab "Reset skills" button (Patch_PsycastTabRespec; "Reset path" spans full row when hidden) and the constellation "Reset specializations" refund button. Dev resets unaffected.
- **Resizable constellation window** — Window_Specializations `resizeable = true` in ctor. `resizer` is PRIVATE in Verse.Window so min-size can't be set (default 150×150). Layout inRect-relative.
- **Pilgrimage completion reforms a caravan (BUG2 fix)** — FireSuccess no longer `site.Destroy()`; keep the pilgrim's site, refresh TimeoutComp to 15 days, send `PS_MsgPilgrimReform`. Vanilla Site has FormCaravan comp + ShouldRemoveMapNow auto-removes once the caravan leaves. Journey uses `DestroyAllSitesExcept(keep)`; FireFail spares a site the pilgrim is on.
- **Modpack-creator balance edits** — (A) `BalanceOverrideDef` (Source/BalanceOverride.cs): `ManualBalance.ApplyOverrideDefs()` folds into the overlay at the END of Load(), ABOVE baked JSON, UNDER PlayerTuning; last def wins. (B) In-game "Import balance edits (from JSON)" → lists `*.json` in `<SaveData>/Psycasts2/` → into PlayerTuning. Wiki xml-triggers.html section 9.

## Bug fixes (2026-07-13, all root-caused)
- **Settings page blanked on toggling "Disable synergies" (+ latently others)** — a checkbox flips its bool on the MouseUp IMGUI pass; a conditional slider gated on the LIVE bool then differs across a frame's passes, corrupting control state and truncating the tab. FIX: every settings tab SNAPSHOTS its toggle-gated rows into locals at frame start (synOn/showCostRow/showCapRow in TabSkills; showBreak/showGate/showTrans in TabMeditation; showEnemy in TabEnemies). See ui lore.
- **Hemosage abilities "Disabled:" with EMPTY reason** — VPE `AbilityExtension_Psycast.IsEnabledForPawn` disables abilities when `!path.CanPawnUnlock && !path.ignoreLockRestrictionsForNeurotrainers` (reason = path.lockedReason). Our lockPathsToEnlightenment forces CanPawnUnlock=false for player pawns. Almost all VPE paths have ignoreLockRestrictionsForNeurotrainers=true (fine), but Hemosage sets it FALSE; disableGeneRequirements had nulled its lockedReason → blank. FIX (HarmonyInit): when lockPathsToEnlightenment is on, set ignoreLockRestrictionsForNeurotrainers=true on every path. See compat lore.
- **"Failed to find sane damage amount"** — our skill tooltip (`PsycastInfo.Scalables`) probed `GetDamageAmount` on carrier projectiles with no damageDef (e.g. Hemosage Blood Shard, damage comes from ability power). FIX: only read projectile damage when `projProps.damageDef != null` (damageAmountBase is private, can't check; such carriers set neither).
- **Patch_AuraToggleGizmo warning** — added `[StaticConstructorOnStartup]` (has a static Texture2D field).
- **Our footer block covered Modern UI's psyset buttons** — Modern Psycasts UI's "Psysets" view REPLACES the whole left panel (`ModernPsycastsDrawer.DrawPsysetPanel`, Back button + Create psyset) when its `psysetMode != 0`. Our `Patch_PsycastTabRespec` footer (Balance editor / Pilgrim's path / Reset skills / Reset path) drew over it. FIX: `ModernUIBridge.PsysetPanelOpen` softly reflects the private static `ModernPsycastsUI.ModernPsycastsDrawer.psysetMode` (lazily-cached FieldInfo; no hard dependency, no-op when absent); the footer postfix early-returns when it's open.

## Celebration FX (SkillFx.cs)
Card-reveal-style bursts (reuses UI/Sparkle + UI/Glow + UI/Specs/node_ring). Grades: Invest, Mastery (at ABSOLUTE cap = maxSkillLevel + SpecEffects.LevelCapBonus, lingering gold border), SpecNode, SpecCapstone. ROUND grades draw NO boxes. **NO BOXES IN THE CONSTELLATION EVER** (user directive): DrawNode capstone frame is a gold RING halo. Mastered trees (Patch_TreeMastered.cs): ONE postfix on PsycastsUIUtility.DoPathAbilities. Dev tool "T: Max all psycast skills (absolute cap)" makes the glow testable. Setting: skillFx (default ON).

## Localization (full keyed layer)
Languages/English/Keyed/ (4 files, ~495 keys), ALL user-facing C# via .Translate(): PS_Lore.xml (incl. PS_MsgPilgrimReform + PS_ThePilgrim), PS_UI.xml, PS_Settings.xml (incl. PS_SetFogOfWar, PS_SetDisableSynergies, PS_SetSynDisabledNote, PS_SetNoSkillReset, PS_SetNoSpecReset, PS_SetImport/Title/Body + PS_MsgImportFailed/NoImportFiles), PS_Specs.xml (GENERATED from Specs.cs). Missing key SHOWS as diacritic gibberish. **Edit user-facing strings in the XML, not in code.**

## Balance feedback: Share JSON export + Import
Specializations tab -> "Balance edits (open beta)": PUBLIC = Share (`ExportPlayerTuning` → `<SaveData>/Psycasts2/BalanceIdeas_<ts>.json`, grouped per tree) + Import + Discard. DEV-MODE = Bake into `<modRoot>/ManualBalance.json`. GOTCHA: GenFilePaths.FolderUnderSaveData is PRIVATE in 1.6 — use GenFilePaths.SaveDataFolderPath.

## No trait system
Enlightenment tier is the PS_Enlightenment hediff (Severity = tier). NO trait; Traits.xml empty.

## Psycaster level cap is FLAT (default 400), tier-independent
vpeLevelCap default 400, overrideVpeLevelCap default true -> ApplyVpeLevelCap writes VPE maxLevel. Patch_LevelCap.EffectiveMax = BaseMax(). Migration balanceVersion 4->5.

## Psylink gate + random Awakened spawn (Patch_EnemyTiers, GenerateNewPawnInternal, Priority.Last)
Postfix: TryInjectTier then GatePsylink (default ON): eligible humanlikes (13+) roll awakenedSpawnChance (0.05) to spawn fresh Awakened; else psylinks stripped. noAwakenedStartingPawns (default ON) exempts PlayerStarter. All gates respect TieringControl.

## Path access & unlock control
`disableGeneRequirements` (default ON): Patch_PathGeneRequirement forces PawnHasGene=true; HarmonyInit strips requiredGene + nulls lockedReason + clears ensureLockRequirement per gated path. `lockPathsToEnlightenment` (default ON): Patch_PathMechMind forces CanPawnUnlock=false for PLAYER pawns only (enemy gen relies on it) — routes unlocks through cards; card pick calls UnlockPath directly. HarmonyInit ALSO forces ignoreLockRestrictionsForNeurotrainers=true on all paths when lockPaths is on (Hemosage fix). `enableLockedMechTrees` re-enables Mech-Mind paths.

## XML Awakening Trigger API
One shared `AwakeningTriggerExtension` DefModExtension + funnel `AwakeningTrigger.Fire(pawn, ext, source)`. 7 surfaces: HediffComp, CompUseEffect, IncidentWorker (PS_Awakening), GameCondition surge (PS_AwakeningSurge), ThoughtDef, PreceptDef, QuestNode/QuestPart. MeditationSystem.Tick calls HourlyScan every 2500 ticks. Docs: docs/wiki/xml-triggers.html.

## TieringOverrideDef — mod-facing ladder handoff
`<PsycastSynergies.TieringOverrideDef>`: disable flags (umbrella `disableBuiltInTiering`) + reskin (tierNames/tierNameBeyondFormat/tierSpecPoints). TieringControl aggregator. Trigger API ignores disables. Wiki section 8.

## ISEKAI RPG compat
suppressIsekaiPsycastStats (default ON): Patch_IsekaiSuppress strips IsekaiLeveling.* StatParts at startup when JellyCreative.IsekaiLeveling active.

## Awakening cards
`cardRevealAll` (default off): remaining cards turned BY HAND, any revealed re-pickable. `cardPickCount` (0=auto 3/5, 1-8 fixed). Window_Awakening `closeOnCancel=false`; only "Choose later" sets aside → `med.pendingPick` (scribed) + `Alert_PendingCardPick`.

## In-game balance editor
psycast tab, dev mode ON -> "Balance editor (dev)". Layering (PsycastInfo): PlayerTuning > ManualBalance.json (baked) + BalanceOverrideDef (modpack XML) > frozenSyn > computed.

## Psycast tab tool block + focus/path pickers (Patch_PsycastTabRespec + ModernUIBridge)
Per-pawn gizmos REMOVED; moved into the psycast tab's bottom tool block (postfix on ITab_Pawn_Psycasts.FillTab — runs for BOTH VPE's tab and Modern UI's drawer). Centered on the left pawn-info card. `ModernUIBridge.LeftCardWidth(tabWidth)` = 340 when Wired else min(size.x*0.3, 340). Focus picking via `ModernPsycastsUI.PawnFocusHooks` (reflection). Footer early-returns when `ModernUIBridge.PsysetPanelOpen` (Modern UI psyset view). Modern Psycasts UI is a WORKSPACE mod (e33ef407d712) — source available for cross-referencing but keep edits in Psycasts².

## Text conventions
"Respec" BANNED (it's "Reset"); "&" BANNED (use "and"); em/en dashes BANNED; sentence case with proper nouns kept (tier names, Enlightenment, Awakening, Tier I/II/III, path/spec names, Trial of the Altar, Way of the Anima, Ancient Psycaster Order, Apotheosis, Dignified, quoted VPE button "Upgrade Psycaster Stats" — string-matched, do NOT change, Mech-Mind). ALL user-facing text lives in Languages/English/Keyed/.

## GitHub Backup & Publishing

- PUBLISHED on Steam Workshop 2026-07-10, PublishedFileId 3761869362 (older ID 3749096772 defunct). If PublishedFileId.txt is deleted in the worktree, ASK before restoring.
- Workshop publishing: user uploads the MOD FOLDER ITSELF. Before upload: move Source/ + docs/ to `D:\Rimworld\Psycasts2\_publish_hold\`; after upload confirmed, move both back.
